retrievalProfile.description: A centered studio portrait of a smiling subject wearing 1980s athletic apparel, featuring wide-tracked geometric sans-serif headers and a secondary gold script sub-header.
triggerTerms: studio portrait with blue jacket and headband

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm-toned studio portrait of a young woman leaning on her hand, wearing a blue track jacket and yellow headband, set against a neutral gradient background with high-contrast gold typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Primary text aligned to the top edge
Secondary script text positioned to the upper right of the subject
Color harmony between gold text and yellow apparel accents
coreInvariants: Wide letter-spacing in the primary display text
Neutral studio backdrop with soft vignetting
Primary subject wearing a blue jacket

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, waist-up, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the central anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold top header, move down to the subject's face, and then to the script text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space at the top and sides to accommodate typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subject's clothing against a muted, low-saturation background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses uniform stroke weight and circular 'O' and 'C' shapes.
Secondary text is a continuous, thin monoline script with a slight upward slant.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely wide tracking for the primary name.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, wide-tracked geometric sans with a fluid, organic script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric uppercase aesthetic of the 80s.
Captures the handwritten, informal feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a young woman with a 1980s hairstyle, wearing a blue track jacket and a yellow headband, leaning on her hand against a neutral grey-brown gradient background. Leave the top 20% of the frame empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a gold geometric sans-serif font with extreme tracking across the top. Add a secondary title in a gold monoline script, slanted upwards, in the upper right quadrant.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text uppercase and widely spaced?
Is the script text gold and slanted?
Is the subject wearing a blue jacket?
Is the background a neutral studio gradient?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the gold color of the text matches the yellow accents in the clothing.
Ensure the tracking of the top text is wide enough to span most of the width.
Verify the script text does not obscure the subject's face.
Confirm the lighting on the subject is soft and directional.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Geometric Sans (Wide Tracking) + Monoline Script (Slanted) + 80s Apparel
